manus: GTA 6 just broke Twitch's all-time record. At its peak, around 3.3 million people were watching GTA 6 streams on Twitch at the same time. That beats League of Legends at 3.1 million, and Fortnite at 3 million. Across Twitch, YouTube and Kick combined, Streams Charts counted almost 7.9 million viewers within three hours of launch. These are third-party numbers, not official Twitch stats. Were you watching? Comment below, and follow for more GTA 6.
